title: GSA OASIS 8(a) - RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL PROGRAM/INTEGRATED RISK  MANAGEMENT SUPPORT SERVICES for US FLEET FORCES COMMAND
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSUP > NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT > NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK > NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description:
The U.S. Fleet Forces Command (USFFC) Risk Management and Internal Control program (RMIC) and Integrated Risk Management (IRM) assistant position maintains compliance with the Federal Managers’ Financial Integrity Act (FMFIA) Public Law 97-255; Office of Budget and Management (OMB) Circular A-123; U.S. Government Office of Accountability (GAO) Standards for Internal Control in the Federal Government; Department of Defense Statement of Assurance Execution Handbook; Department of Defense Instruction (DoDI) 5010.40, DoD Enterprise Risk Management and Risk Management and Internal Control Program; Department of the Navy Integrated Risk Management Program Handbook; and OPNAV Instruction 5200.25, Risk Management and  
Internal Controls Program. This includes all matters of importance to the Navy and Commander, USFFC, with particular emphasis on advising and coordinating with stakeholders responsible for executing the principles of fraud risk assessment; entity-level controls evaluation; risk evaluation and management; and internal control evaluation.
